<infobox theme="Comic">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="title"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Attribution information</header>
        <data source="writer"><label>Writer</label></data>	
        <data source="artist"><label>Artist(s)</label></data>			
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Publication information</header>	
        <data source="start date"><label>First published</label><format><!--
        -->{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{start date|}}}}}|none||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{start date|}}}}}|future||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{start date|}}}}}|canceled||{{{start date}}}}}}}}}<!--
        --></format></data>	
        <data source="end date"><label>Last published</label></data>
        <data source="published in"><label>Published in</label></data>	
        <data source="pages"><label>Page count</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Chronology</header>
        <data source="timeline"><label>Timeline</label></data>
        <data source="series"><label>Series</label></data>
        <data source="preceded by"><label>Preceded by</label></data>
        <data source="followed by"><label>Followed by</label></data>			
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Webstrip|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
-->{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|title|writer|artist|pages|start date|end date|published in|timeline|series|preceded by|followed by|optional=no_year_check,not_appearance|ignore=name}}<!--
-->{{#invoke:MediaDateCheck|main|no_year_check={{{no_year_check|}}}|sort_key=W}}<includeonly>{{AppMediaCat|not_appearance={{{not_appearance|}}}}}</includeonly><noinclude>[[category:Comic infoboxes]]{{Clear}}

<pre>{{Webstrip
|image=
|title=
|writer=
|artist=
|start date=

|preceded by=
|followed by=
}}</pre></noinclude>
